subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “After a storm cut electricity, phones slowly ran out of battery.”?
options: Mia had thought the radio was old-fashioned.
There is an old radio in Mr. Wang's noodle shop.
Mia thought her brother ate it.
With the old camera, every photo cost money.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Mia had thought the radio was old-fashioned.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「There is an old radio in Mr. Wang's noodle shop.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
